newsitem.title: UK: Hanson posts demerger details on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Hanson posts demerger details on schedule.

text.p: Anglo-U.S. basic industries group Hanson Plc sent out full details of its planned demerger on Wednesday, showing that its plans to spin off two companies this year and one more in early 1997 remain on track.
As expected, the demergers of Imperial Tobacco Group Plc and Millennium Chemicals Inc are due to be effective from October 1.
"Excellent management is in place and I look forward with great confidence to their future performance," Lord Hanson said of the first two new offspring in a letter to shareholders.
Stockholders will be asked to approve the two demegers formally at an extraordinary general meeting on September 25.

Assuming all preconditions are met, dealings in Hanson ordinary shares in London will include the entitlement to receive Millennium Chemicals common stock and Imperial Tobacco ordinary shares until the close of business on September 30.
Dealings in Imperial are expected to start on October 1, while Millennium is expected to be listed on the NYSE with "regular way trading" starting on October 2.
Thus, in the U.S., Hanson ADSs will trade with the entitlement to receive Millennium common stock and Imperial Tobacco ADSs until the close of business on October 1.
Allocations will be on the previously-announced basis.
The Energy Group, the third and final part of the Hanson group to be separated out, will remain in Hanson until early 1997, when it will "go its own way", Lord Hanson added.

Unlike Millennium and Imperial, which are predominantly U.S.- and British-based companies respectively, Energy will mix one large U.S.-based business, Peabody Coal, and a major British electricity generator and distirbutor, Eastern Group.

Once Energy has left the fold, the remainder of Hanson Plc will be a building materials and services group with interests ranging from bricks in Europe to aggregates, asphalt and crane hire in many countries, including the United States.
